scope: Synthetic production-shaped Persona/Scene to Tavern shadow-quality experiment; operational v3 evidence is separate from research semantic review.

diagnosis.adapter_budget_bug: The adapter omitted openai_setting_max_tokens, producing 1400-token initial Scene calls and 2200-token repair calls; multiple HTTP 200 responses ended with finish_reason=length and invalid JSON.
diagnosis.repair_boundary_bug: Strict SceneTreeProposal validation ran after the provider JSON repair boundary, so reuse_hint=null produced setting_scene_proposal_invalid:scene_layers.0.reuse_hint:string_type without a repair attempt.
remaining_model_failures: adaptive: both 4096 and 6144 attempts exhausted output with finish_reason=length
disabled: both strict attempts failed scene_selected_path_invalid

independent_manual_review.attribution_note: Each arm used one deterministic Scene fallback after a failed Scene proposal; those visible artifact scores are not M3 Scene quality attribution.
independent_manual_review.decision: Do not promote thinking-disabled or a content prompt strategy; retain independent manual review because lexical checks produced both false positives and false negatives.

post_review_corrections.historical_report_state_note: v5/v6 candidate_failed states predate this correction and are not a semantic failure rate.

limitations: Four synthetic development families are not an independent held-out or expert-quality gate.
Lexical required/forbidden checks are triage only and cannot establish semantic fidelity.
Tavern primary_output_only commit evidence proves the Message projection, not all Room/Run/Step side effects.
Persona and Scene generation commit evidence remains not_applicable; user save/read-back is a separate boundary.
